description: Treat Fig. 3 only as an object-level image lead; accept no sign-level segmentation.
test: Acquire CISI/HARP record or higher-resolution image with side labels and compare to both local rows.
would_support: Caption identity plus source record confirms one visible side is 3556.1 and companion side is 3556.2.
would_kill: CISI/HARP says Fig. 3 right image is M-2016 or another object, or local two-row pairing is wrong.

description: Visible top row is read in the displayed order as a three-group sequence aligned with +520-220-034+.
test: Check whether source image/caption/side record places lipi 034 at the right terminal V/triangle-like group after direction conventions are applied.
would_support: CISI/HARP side record confirms displayed M-1206 top inscription corresponds to +520-220-034+ with 034 at that terminal group.
would_kill: Source direction/mirror convention places 034 elsewhere or shows a different sign count.

description: Because article images face as impressed and local dir. is R/L, the local token order may not equal displayed left-to-right order.
test: Use source direction basis to determine whether +520-220-034+ is reading order, visual order, or normalized catalogue order.
would_support: The same three visible sign groups match the local row after a documented mirror/order transform.
would_kill: No documented transform can reconcile visible groups with +520-220-034+.

description: M-1206 is a two-side object where the short 034 row must be interpreted together with +740-690-435-255-002-861+ only if both sides are source-confirmed.
test: Acquire all-side source images and side labels; verify that one side has the visible three-sign row and the other has the six-sign row.
would_support: Both local rows are physically distinct sides of the same object with source-visible inscriptions.
would_kill: The six-sign row is not on the same artifact, is a duplicate/copy/catalogue artifact, or is not visible.

description: The bison/gaur image and Bhaskar iconographic argument must not determine the value of 034.
test: Run any future 034 hypothesis against non-bison/gaur 034 controls and M-1206 companion-side controls before accepting a semantic claim.
would_support: 034 behavior survives outside the M-1206 bison/gaur iconographic context.
would_kill: 034 signal collapses to image-class or source-selection bias.
